# Vendor Skills

This directory records previously installed official and third-party skills and how to recreate them.

The repository intentionally avoids publishing runtime folders, `node_modules`, caches, generated outputs, checkpoints, datasets, and large binary assets.

## Previously Installed Skills

### Official / Curated

- `openai-docs` from `openai/skills`, path `skills/.curated/openai-docs`
